glosses: Donner à (un mot) un nouvel emploi, en tant que substantif.
To use as or change into a noun, often by affixing a morpheme.

examples.text: To nominalize an adjective that refers to a known noun, the articles el, la, los, and las are used (Unit 11 §59); to nominalize an adjective that does not refer to a known noun, the neuter article lo is used.
But, Dretske asks, what happens when we nominalize a propositional allomorph?
